title: refactor(rest): move the /meta type list, maintenance and per-type list routes into meta-collection-routes.ts (#23050 slice 13a)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Sub-slice **13a** of the `rest-server.ts` split: the first three `/meta` groups. Groups G1 + G2 + G3 of `RestServer#registerMetadataEndpointsInner` (base `:5298`–`:5740`, 443 lines) move, re-indented one level, to one new module, `packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts`. They are the type list (`GET {metaPath}` and `GET {metaPath}/types`, one handler on two paths), the whole-store maintenance family (`GET /diagnostics`, `GET /_drafts`, `POST /_migrate-stored`) and the per-type list (`GET /:type`): seven routes per base. This follows the slicing plan (`os-dev-report` `6239704287`, sub-slice 13a), the seat's ruling `6239783526` (Q1 A, Q2 A, Q3 A and the binding host rule) and static-receiver ruling A `6205442867`. The claim is `6239807713`.

Nothing else moves:
- the route table, the ordered server registrations, every server-visible handler and every INNER registration (method, path, metadata, arity, handler digest) are identical, base vs head, in 20 configurations;
- the published `dist/index.d.ts` / `index.d.cts` are byte-identical, and so are both bundles' 39-name export lists;
- one token of the moved body changed, the ruled receiver (below).

`rest-server.ts` goes from 9,086 to 8,681 lines. G4–G8, the umbrella `registerMetadataEndpoints` and its guarded swap, the inner head's four bindings, every handler body and `meta-item-read-gate.ts` are untouched. #23050 stays open for 13b–13e.

✅ **`check-system-context-census` is green (patch round 1, `d6a423356`).** The plan did not list `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` for 13a, but the `_migrate-stored` door's `if (!ctx?.isSystem && !held.has('manage_metadata'))` is an elevation read site, and it moved (base `rest-server.ts:5547` → `meta-collection-routes.ts:452`). At `1e0153a68` the census read `[file-without-a-row] packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts holds 1 elevation read site(s) in 1 symbol(s) (registerMetaCollectionRoutes)` (exit 1). Under the claim amendment `6241851688`, declared to the page's lane on #6023 as `6241845161`, row 50 (`manage_metadata` bypassed on metadata writes) gains one anchor, `packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts#registerMetaCollectionRoutes`, beside `rest-server.ts#registerMetadataEndpointsInner`. No other line of the page and none of the row's prose changed. The census now reads `OK — 142 elevation read sites … over 158 anchors` (exit 0; 157 before). The inner anchor stays valid, because three reads are still there: the per-item `DELETE` (G5) and `publish` / `rollback` (G6).

## The shape

**Moved, at their position.** In the inner method, right after `registerPerItemRoute`'s declaration, the head now builds `const scope: MetaRouteScope = { metadata, metaPath, isScoped, registerPerItemRoute };` once (head `:5313`, Q1 A). At the moved statements' old position it builds the host literal `collectionHost` and calls `registerMetaCollectionRoutes.call(collectionHost, scope)` (head `:5324`–`:5335`). Registration order is unchanged, with the literal segments still above `/:type`.

**The host, `MetaCollectionRouteHost`: 9 members in first-read order** (an AST walk of the moved range, TypeScript 6.0.3, identical on base and head):

| member | reads | handed over as |
|---|---:|---|
| `resolveProtocol` | 5 | closure `(...a) => this.resolveProtocol(...a)` |
| `translateMetaTypesResponse` | 1 | closure |
| `routeManager` | 6 (all `register`, registration time) | **by value, captured inside the inner method** |
| `resolveExecCtx` | 3 | closure, spelled exactly as the execctx census's forwarder |
| `walledCatalogRefusal` | 1 | closure |
| `resolveMetaWriteActor` | 1 | closure |
| `refuseUnknownMetaListType` | 1 | closure |
| `metaListAnswerSources` | 1 | closure |
| `metaTypeSingular` (private static) | 1 | closure `(...a) => RestServer.metaTypeSingular(...a)`, typed `(typeof RestServer)['metaTypeSingular']` |

The body has no bare `this`, no `this[...]`, no `function` keyword and no assignment to a `this` member.

**Host placement (binding).** The literal is built inside `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, where `this.routeManager` is the umbrella's wrapping registrar for exactly the duration of the call. It is not built in `registerRoutes`, the constructor, an instance cache or the umbrella above the swap. The module header and the comment above the literal say why. The guard ablation below is the runtime proof.

**The scope (Q1 A).** `MetaRouteScope` types `metadata` as `RestServer['config']['metadata']`. The module opens with one destructuring line, `const { metadata, metaPath, isScoped } = scope;`, the three bindings it reads (`noUnusedLocals` / `noUnusedParameters`). `registerPerItemRoute` is handed over as the inner method's own closure; this module does not call it.

**The one changed token (ruling A).** The per-type list's `RestServer.metaTypeSingular(req.params.type)` (base `:5719`) is `this.metaTypeSingular(req.params.type)` at module `:624`.

**Module-level names** (the same walk, base vs head):
- Unchanged provenance: `handleRouteError` and `sendFieldVisibilityFault` (`./error-response.js`), `refuseRepeatedQueryParams` (`./query-multiplicity.js`), `rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable` (`@objectstack/core`), `metaReadGate` (namespace, `./meta-item-read-gate.js`) and `GetMetaItemsRequest` (type, `@objectstack/spec/api`). Every one of them is still read in `rest-server.ts`, so no import line left it (tsc `noUnusedLocals` exit 0).
- `metaItemPackageBinding` (on the package entry) and `mayReadPendingDrafts` (the analytics module imports it) are declared in `rest-server.ts`, stay there and are imported from it. Both were already exported, so no export was added anywhere.
- `TransportScopedMetaRequest` (Q2 A) moved verbatim from `ui-routes.ts` (base `:54`–`:93`) to the new module (`:104`–`:143`). The block extracts byte-identical on both sides (`diff` exit 0, sha256 `f10f65831fde621b…`). It sits beside the new `MetaRouteScope` block.

## Proof

All runs went through `os-verify-lock`, with every exit captured before any pipe. The base is `8259ea03e`, built before any edit. The head is `4cb131087`, and the merge head `1e0153a68` was measured against `origin/main` `b7f29ddfe`.

**1. The moved text.** `git show 8259ea03e:packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts | sed -n 5298,5740p`, with one 4-space indent removed, was compared with `meta-collection-routes.ts` `:203`–`:645`, the body after the destructuring line.
- The raw `diff` exits 1 on exactly one line: base 422 of the range, the receiver token.
- With `this.metaTypeSingular(` mapped back to `RestServer.metaTypeSingular(`, `diff` exits 0 over all 443 lines. Both sides are sha256 `7f562178bdc5c4c487f821ef0f13df8082ce613b2b3668390bbcc2bc8ca511f7`.
- Every non-empty line of the range carries the 8-space indent. No line has trailing whitespace or an odd backtick count.

**2. `.d.ts` and exports.** `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` are sha256 `1f0f455d24836d47de60716233f1bd74d1738c04046974019264b17b5261bbe8` at base, at head, at `origin/main` (that leg put main's `rest-server.ts`, `ui-routes.ts` and `form-routes.ts` into the merged tree under a trap, without the new module) and at the merge head. `cmp` exits 0 on every pair.
- The head-only marker `registerMetaCollectionRoutes` hits 2 in each of `index.js` / `index.cjs`, and 0 at base and on the main leg.
- Both bundles load with 39 exports and one sorted name list, sha256 `b3246be6a1718700…`, on every leg.

**3. Full-boot legs (slice 12's method), 20 configurations:**
- slice 12's thirteen: default; scoped-optional; scoped-required; every provider set; `enableDiscovery: false`; `enableOpenApi: false`; both off under scoped-optional; `enableSearch: false` and `enableUi: false` under scoped-optional; `enableCrud: false` under scoped-optional; `crud.operations` `{ list: false, delete: false }` under scoped-optional; all five operations off; `crud.dataPrefix: '/objects'` under scoped-optional;
- the `/meta` switches, all under scoped-optional: `metadata.endpoints.types`, `.items`, `.item` and `.maintenance` each false; all four false; `metadata.prefix: '/metadata'`; `api.enableMetadata: false`.

The route counts are 75 / 150 / 75 / 75 / 73 / 73 / 142 / 148 / 148 / 138 / 144 / 69 / 150 (slice 12's figures), then 146 / 148 / 126 / 144 / 114 / 150 / 112. In the source leg, `routes.json` (`getRoutes()`, functions as arity), `calls.json` (ordered server registrations with arity) and `handlers.json` (a whitespace-free sha256 of every server-visible handler) are byte-identical in all 20 configs, on four trees: base, head, main and merge head. Their concatenation is sha256 `08103834505ba94cd81c227c14e1c2b8dd21eb6dbd1d894d7ba7557a9f2db9ba` on all four. A second base run was identical. In the bundle leg (the same dump against the built `dist/index.js`), routes and calls are identical. The handler text differs only at the 19 `/meta` guard wrappers per base, and only by esbuild renumbering the `@objectstack/core` import alias inside the wrapper. The new module comes earlier in bundle order and now holds the bare name, so `rest-server.ts`' `rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable` is bundled as `rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable2`, and a later module's `…2` becomes `…3`. With that renumbering normalized, all 150 registrations are identical. The head bundle's identifier set gains exactly `collectionHost`, `registerMetaCollectionRoutes` and `rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable3`, and loses none.

**4. The inner-registration leg (the plan's `proof_method`).** Slice 12's digest is blind to `/meta`: every server-visible `/meta` handler is the umbrella's one wrapper, so the full-boot legs cannot see a moved body. Each config therefore also builds a `RestServer` with a recording `routeManager` and calls `registerMetadataEndpointsInner(basePath)` directly for `/api/v1` and `/api/v1/environments/:environmentId`. That gives 688 recorded registrations over the 20 configs (19 per base where every switch is on). Each is digested whitespace-free, with the receiver token mapped back, together with its method, path, metadata and arity.
- **Source leg (vitest transform):** 688 of 688 identical, base vs head and main vs merge head. The digest-list sha256 is `2ab528c22577ded382806107cd8e484de7d525d92e7148685af9533a9bf75bdc`, and a second base run gave the same.
  - Two transform spellings are normalized, and both are declared. The first is the SSR import index `__vite_ssr_import_N__`, whose number shifts in every later handler of `rest-server.ts` because that file gained one import. Raw, this alone moves all 38 digests per config, G4–G8 included. Only the number is erased; the imported name is kept.
  - The second is the `(0, ns.f)` call spelling of the two helpers the module now imports from `rest-server.ts`: `metaItemPackageBinding` and `mayReadPendingDrafts`.
  - Provenance is the AST table above.
- **Bundle leg (built `dist/index.js`):** 688 of 688 identical, base vs head and main vs merge head. The digest-list sha256 is `4495c6eb055d3f27e9852d172f466ae28e2596a3b72bd036159013f86ad3b862`. The normalizations are esbuild's class-internal receiver `_RestServer.` and the alias renumbering above.
- **Positive control.** One character was added to the moved `_drafts` handler through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `'protocol.listDrafts() is not available in this kernel'` gained a `!` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `3e38c8ff50bf` → `7ae2b239f2e1`).
  - The inner digests moved at exactly `GET …/_drafts`, on both bases, in the 18 configs that mount it: 36 of 688, and nowhere else.
  - All 20 configs' full-boot `routes` / `calls` / `handlers` stayed byte-identical. That is the blind spot the inner leg exists to cover.
  - Restored: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**5. The guard ablation.** One literal anchor ran from the umbrella's `const realRouteManager = this.routeManager;` to the host's `routeManager: this.routeManager,` (blob `43a35f016343` → `8bf281899dfe`; the on-disk marker count during the run was 2). The mutation stashes the real manager above the swap, and the host reads it: the plan's wrong placement.
- **Head** (identical to base, sha256 `a7efce0b390ea680…`): an anonymous request at every moved route on both bases — GET METAPATH, METAPATH/types, /diagnostics, /_drafts, POST /_migrate-stored, GET /:type — answers `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` with zero protocol calls, 12 of 12.
- **Ablation:**
  - `GET` METAPATH, `/types`, `/diagnostics` and `/:type` answer `200` after a protocol read.
  - `/_drafts` and `POST /_migrate-stored` answer `403 FORBIDDEN` from their own capability checks, not the anonymous-deny.
  - Not one of the 12 is `401`.
- **Standing pins under the ablation:** `Test Files 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`, `Tests 14 failed | 86 passed (100)`.
  - `rest-meta-auth.test.ts` is red twice ("401s an anonymous caller", "still 401s an anonymous /meta/object"; `expected 200 to be 401`).
  - `meta-type-read-capability.test.ts` is red 12 times: the `/:type` shape for datasource, datasources, external_catalog and external_catalogs × author / member / other-grant (`expected { shape: '/:type', status: 200, … } to deeply equal { shape: '/:type', status: 403, … }`).
  - `meta-type-write-capability.test.ts` stays green, because no moved route is a non-GET `/:type…` door.
  - GET METAPATH, `/types`, `/diagnostics` and `/_drafts` have no standing anonymous pin; the one-off probe above is the evidence for them.
- Restored: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No permanent test was added.

**6. The late-binding ablation** (one-off vitest file, deleted). The setup is slices 11 and 12's: the seven methods and the static are planted on the server before `registerRoutes()`, the seven moved routes are driven, everything is planted again after registration, and the routes are driven again.
- **Head** (byte-identical `MEASURE` lines to base): every route answers `200` both times. After the second planting all eight members are reached as `late`, with `early calls after re-plant: 0`. `Tests 1 passed (1)`.
- **Ablation:** `resolveProtocol: this.resolveProtocol.bind(this)` (blob `43a35f016343` → `8e763954d37d`) gives `early calls after re-plant: 12` (six `early:resolveProtocol` and their six protocol reads) and `AssertionError: expected [ 'early:resolveProtocol', …(11) ] to deeply equal []`, `Tests 1 failed (1)`. Restored: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

`rest-server-registrar-files.ts` gains `meta-collection-routes.ts` (length 13 → 14). It also exports **`REST_SERVER_META_ROUTE_FILES`** (Q3 A), the list's named subset of the files that hold a moved `/meta` group, today `['meta-collection-routes.ts']`. Subset entries are named file by file, never by a naming convention.

| reader | sum over the list | change |
|---|---|---|
| `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` | 62 sites = 13 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 0 + 6 + 3; mentions 129 → 133 | The three moved sites (`_drafts`, `_migrate-stored`, `/:type`) are all locally caught, as before, so the split stays 16 / 46. The four new mentions are the seam: the forwarder, two, and the interface member, two. `rest-server.ts` goes 56 → 55. There are 14 forwarders, (14 − 1) + 3 − 2, so neither map gains an entry |
| `meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts` | 8 = 3 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 2 + 0 ×7 + 3 | `_drafts`' two switches and the list's `?preview=draft` moved. Keys name routes, not files, so no ledger row changed |
| `rest-server-query-number-census.test.ts` | 9 = 8 + 1 + 0 ×12 | — |
| `rest-server-canonical-query-ast.test.ts` (`repo`) | 4 = 0 + 3 + 0 ×10 + 1 + 0 | Floor `meta-collection-routes.ts: 0`. The list's `query` key is mid-line in the chain's options literal, which `querySlots` does not read |
| `rest-server-docblock-position.test.ts` | floors 4 + 3 + 3 + 8 + 3 + 8 + 5 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 5 = 54 | `ui-routes.ts` 4 → 3 (the alias's block moved on). `meta-collection-routes.ts` 5: header, alias, `MetaRouteScope`, host and function. `rest-server.ts` keeps its 163 |
| `ui-view-route-identity` / `-tenancy` measurement tests | `this.enforceAuth(` 60, `this.resolveExecCtx(` 75 → 76 | +1 for the forwarder. The ownership guard is still 1 call site and 1 forwarder |
| dogfood `authz-conformance.test.ts` | 0 tripwire hits over the fourteen files | Length 13 → 14 |
| dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` | 70 / 19 / 51 unchanged | **Rule (Q3 A):** reachable = the umbrella slice's sites plus every site in `REST_SERVER_META_ROUTE_FILES` (13 + 6). New controls are `meta-collection-routes.ts: this.routeManager.register(` 6, and `/meta subset ↔ .call( inside registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, measured over the inner method's own extent (1) and recorded AS `REST_SERVER_META_ROUTE_FILES.length`, so the subset and the module calls can only move together. `this.routeManager.register(` stays 63 = 6 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 6 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 6 + 6. `registerPerItemRoute(` stays 8 and `enforceAuth` stays 112, because neither the moved text nor the seam spells the term |

Readers outside the list:
- **`scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`** (`domain:spec` target table; declared on #6017, `6239822550`). `meta-collection-routes.ts` is declared `dialectOnly` with ratchet #9559, at `stringError 0` / `siblingCode 0` (measured). `rest-server.ts` stays 8 / 4, with "8 → 8" and "4 → 4" notes. The sums are unchanged at 39 and 54. Its output differs from base only by the new row: 24 → 25 modules audited, 14 → 15 ratcheted.
- **`packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json`** (declared on #6017, `6239822550`). Three evidence paths change, `rest-server.ts#registerMetadataEndpointsInner` → `meta-collection-routes.ts#registerMetaCollectionRoutes`: the `endpoints.types`, `endpoints.items` and `endpoints.maintenance` rows. Quoted code, producers, verdicts and statuses are unchanged. `prefix` stays, because `metaPath` is built in the inner head. `check:liveness` reads `945 pointer(s) … 945 naming a symbol` and `735 … pair(s) asked, 734 anchored, 1 exempt` on base and head.
- **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`** (declared on #6023, `6239832477`):
  - In `api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract`, `+ packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts#registerMetaCollectionRoutes (the types, items and maintenance endpoint gates)` is added beside the inner anchor (slice 7's split form). The inner anchor's parenthetical goes from "the four endpoint gates" to "the item endpoint gate", the one gate still in that method. That wording change goes slightly past the declaration's "added beside", and it is named here so the devx seat can see it.
  - `studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep`: `rest-server.ts#route` (it pointed at an unrelated loop variable) → `meta-collection-routes.ts#registerMetaCollectionRoutes`.
  - `check:platform-checklist`: 853/863 → 854/864 anchors found, and cited sources go 401 → 402.
- **`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`** (patch round 1; claim amendment `6241851688`, declared on #6023 as `6241845161`). Row 50 gains `packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts#registerMetaCollectionRoutes` beside the inner anchor, in the row's existing spelling. The row's prose is unchanged.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`** (a loud cross-package reader). The list derivation reads `META_COLLECTION_ROUTES_SOURCE`; the item, tree and layers derivations still read `rest-server.ts`. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` exits 0.
- **`TransportScopedMetaRequest` readers (Q2 A).**
  - `ui-routes.ts`: the block leaves, an import is added, and a pointer comment plus the header sentence are re-pointed.
  - `form-routes.ts`: the import and its header sentence.
  - `rest-server.ts`: the import, and slice 10's pointer comment.
  - The docblock floors are in the table above. `meta-item-read-gate.ts` is not touched.

**Red before the re-points**, each measured with the readers at their base text:
- **At the move commit `3f5191027`:**
  - `local` read `Test Files 3 failed | 290 passed (293)`, `Tests 9 failed | 6013 passed | 326 skipped (6348)`: the execctx census (`expected 59 to be 62`), the draft census (`expected [ …(5) ] to deeply equal [ …(8) ]`) and the `ui-routes.ts` docblock floor (`expected 3 to be greater than or equal to 4`).
  - The dogfood pair read `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)`: `expected 64 to be 70` and `this.routeManager.register(` 57 vs 63.
  - The runtime parity test read `Tests 1 failed | 738 passed (739)`: `GET ${metaPath}/:type in …/rest-server.ts: expected false to be true`.
  - `check:route-envelope` exited 1: `meta-collection-routes.ts NOT DECLARED`.
  - `repo` stayed `5 passed`, because the moved groups carry no `query:` slot.
- **At `9a2ba1355`** (the list grown, the readers not yet re-pointed):
  - The six list readers read `Test Files 6 failed (6)`, `Tests 8 failed | 116 passed (124)`: the length pins (`to have a length of 13 but got 14`), the `ui-routes.ts` floor and the unfloored module.
  - `repo` read `Tests 2 failed | 260 passed | 14 skipped (276)`.
  - The dogfood pair read `Tests 3 failed | 105 passed (108)`, including `expected 13 to be 19`. That is the false reachable reading the Q3 rule exists to prevent.
- **Green after the re-point** (`5a281fe51`, then the merge head).

## Readers examined and not re-pointed

- The inner method's docblock, the umbrella's docblock and `registerPerItemRoute`'s docblock still describe the families, the order and the switch correctly, and editing a class member's docblock would move the published `.d.ts`.
- The moved G3 comment naming `meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` moved with its handler and is still true.
- `data-action-routes.ts`' `{@link TransportScopedMetaRequest}` is prose that names no file.
- The authz-conformance probe `private registerMetadataEndpoints(` and its dead-probe control are unaffected, because the umbrella stays.

## Changesets

- `.changeset/23050-s13a-meta-collection-routes-move.md` is a `@objectstack/rest` patch (`Clause-②: no`, move-only). The shipped `index.js` / `index.cjs` bytes change (the marker above); the declarations and exports do not.
- `.changeset/23050-s13a-meta-collection-liveness-citations.md` is a `@objectstack/spec` patch (`Clause-②: no`), because `liveness/` ships in that package's `files[]`.
- `skip-changeset` does not apply.

- `system-context.mdx` row 50 gained its one anchor in patch round 1 (`d6a423356`). 13b–13e each add their module to the same row, as the plan already lists.

## Gates and tests

The final head is `1e0153a68`, one merge of `origin/main` `b7f29ddfe` (#24208, #24209, #24212). Those three touch none of this diff's files (`git diff --quiet` exit 0 over the overlap), and `rest-server.ts`, `ui-routes.ts` and `form-routes.ts` are byte-identical across `8259ea03e..b7f29ddfe`. Patch round 1 adds `d6a423356`, one line of `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`. That page is no package's build input and no test reads it (two test files mention it in comments only), so no proof leg moves and the suites below stand at `1e0153a68`. The gate union below was re-run at `d6a423356`.

- **Build.** `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/rest... --filter=@objectstack/dogfood... --filter=@objectstack/runtime... --concurrency=2` exited 0 at base (`Tasks: 66 successful, 66 total`). After the merge, the five packages the merge touched were rebuilt (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter …metadata-protocol --filter …platform-objects --filter …runtime --filter …cli --filter …rest build`, exit 0). The eight workspace packages with no `dist` (`client-react`, `embedder-openai`, `knowledge-memory`, `knowledge-ragflow`, `organizations`, `service-cluster-redis`, `service-knowledge`, `studio`) were built for the dist readers (exit 0).
- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` exits 0: `check:test-typecheck: OK … 0 file(s) / 0 error(s)`.
- **`@objectstack/rest`.** `local`: `Test Files 294 passed (294)`, `Tests 6027 passed | 326 skipped (6353)`. This includes `meta-route-registration-order.test.ts` and `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts`. `repo` (its `test:repo`): `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 262 passed | 14 skipped (276)`.
- **Dogfood pair** (`authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`, `authz-conformance.test.ts`): `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 108 passed (108)`. The dogfood shards skip on PRs and in the queue, so this local run is the evidence.
- **Spec liveness suites** (`packages/spec` `local`, `scripts/liveness/`): `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 269 passed (269)`.
- **`test:repo`.** `@objectstack/core`: `Tests 86 passed (86)`. `@objectstack/runtime`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 808 passed (808)`; `meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` is one of the three. `@objectstack/spec`: `Test Files 67 passed (67)`, `Tests 1115 passed (1115)`.
- **Lint.** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the 16 changed `.ts` / `.mjs` files exits 0, with no output. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.
- **Gate union.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) at `d6a423356` derives 118 commands; its stderr names the commit, and the `--repo` assertion holds. The change set is 22 paths vs merge base `b7f29ddfe`, 1,442 changed lines (+921 / −521).
